name: context-gauge
description: Context-window usage as a small coloured 'ctx NN%' in the prompt footer: green below 30%, yellow 30-40%, red above 40%. /ctx prints the breakdown by category.

yellowAt.title: Yellow from (%)
yellowAt.description: The gauge turns yellow at this percent of the context window. Default 30.

redAbove.title: Red above (%)
redAbove.description: The gauge turns red above this percent. Default 40, ten points before an auto-compact set at 50%.

site.title: Where to draw
site.description: "footer" (default): beside the mode labels at the right of the prompt footer. "hint": after the hint line under the prompt. "band": the band above the prompt. "status": the plugin status line under the prompt, uncoloured.
